platform: Windows; OpenGL Compatibility; NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti; Dummy audio
test_method: Production autoloads, actual scenes and Viewport mouse/key events in disposable APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA. No normal player save writes. Fullscreen QA overrides only the disposable test window, not player settings.
resolution_note: Initial 1920 windowed captures were physically clamped by Windows to 1886x1061. They are excluded from final evidence. The final 1920 run uses fullscreen; every PNG IHDR was checked.
scope: Scene regression and inspected rendered pages; not full manual P6 or final art/story approval. Native masters are 1672x941 (some 1671x941), accurately recorded in ART.json.
source_hash_policy: UTF-8 text normalized to LF without BOM; binary art and captures are hashed byte-for-byte.
